accounting: Each scored neighbor counts, including repeats across representatives. Initial objective and dual certificate checks are separate. At most three admitted reflection classes including the start.
move_stream_serialization: ASCII flattened removed coordinates, added coordinates, score, comma separated plus LF. Separate SHA256 per state and order.
order: FIFO first-seen raw representatives; exact one-exchanges before exact two-exchanges; lexicographic removed then originally vacant added combinations.
outputs: study.json with histograms, BFS edges, orbit images, statuses and hashes
question: Does the equal-score one/two-exchange component of the fixed 7x7 20-point witness admit any improving edge?
quotient: Only board-preserving x reflection, y reflection, both, and identity. No transposition or translation. These metric-preserving graph automorphisms make scanning one representative per orbit sufficient to detect every improving edge reachable via equal-score moves.
stopping: Stop at first improvement, candidate cap, or runtime cap. State cap prevents admission but scans already admitted states; any unadmitted class makes closure incomplete. COMPLETE requires every admitted neighborhood exhausted and no blocked equal classes or early stop. IMPROVEMENT_FOUND is not closure.
strict_baseline: Shares the same initial scan, rejects equal scores, reports first improving edge or STUCK only after full initial scan. This is a deterministic strict-descent control, not a separate stochastic fixed-budget benchmark.
